name: io.github.pradigmaz/obsidian-knowledge-mcp
description: Knowledge-focused Obsidian MCP fork with core tools and Knowledge Analytics integrations.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (Settings → Community Plugins → Local REST API).

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:27123 (enable "Non-encrypted (HTTP) Server" in plugin settings). Use https://127.0.0.1:27124 for the always-on HTTPS port (self-signed cert; pair with OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL=false).

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate on the Obsidian endpoint. Default false because the plugin uses a self-signed cert.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_ENABLE_COMMANDS
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in flag for the command-palette pair (obsidian_list_commands + obsidian_execute_command). Off by default — Obsidian commands are opaque and can be destructive.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; trailing slashes normalized. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for writes. Same syntax as OBSIDIAN_READ_PATHS. Unset = full vault. Example: 'projects/,scratch/'.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_OMNISEARCH_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override URL for the Omnisearch plugin HTTP server. Unset derives from OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL host with port 51361. Required only if the Omnisearch plugin is not on the default port.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_KNOWLEDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Knowledge Analytics Obsidian plugin HTTP endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_DEPENDENCY_STARTUP
environmentVariables.description: Whether MCP startup prepares local dependencies before tools are used.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_START_OBSIDIAN
environmentVariables.description: Whether MCP startup quietly launches Obsidian when the Knowledge Analytics endpoint is not ready.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_EXECUTABLE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional executable path for background Obsidian startup. On Windows, defaults to LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Obsidian\Obsidian.exe.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_STARTUP_URI
environmentVariables.description: URI argument passed to Obsidian during background startup.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_DEPENDENCY_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum startup wait for local dependencies, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
